notes.title: Full Game Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d01d3830acba925c4fa0421e68d0607391a1cb18.jpg[/img]

Heya,

The day has come: SuchArt is now fully and officially out. Thank you so much for supporting us all the way through the Early Access – the game wouldn’t reach its current state without your feedback, as well as there would be no community without you actively participating in the life of the [url=https://discord.gg/T4jZyTQ]SuchArt discord server[/url] and painting your masterpieces. So yeah, your contribution cannot be overestimated, and we truly appreciate it.

[previewyoutube=0F_GxnR9I28;full][/previewyoutube]

Since today is a big day indeed, you can grab SuchArt with a 20% launch discount. Moreover, you can get an additional 15% off if you purchase it as a part of our bundle with House Flipper – quite a bargain, isn’t it?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

Don’t forget that we’re also running a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293180/view/3556180117860357344]contest[/url] in which you can win SuchArt Steam key and help us spread the word about the game at the same time – make sure to check it out!

But let’s move to the most interesting part – the new stuff we promised to tell you about (spoiler: no worries, your saves should remain safe and sound!).

[h3]Hangar[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/99a832af302d3ab2303eb59c9c1179a82fdd6b6c.png[/img]

The hangar is a new spacious area distinct from your studio. A new space with its own game mechanics, items, characters and commissions. It brings larger and more complex items to paint in game, and aims to bring more variety to the mid and late game.

=> It is unlocked shortly after reaching the 4th level of fame. You will get an email from a new character. If you load a save past this level of fame, you should quickly receive the email as well. It is also always available in Creative mode.

[h3]Gallery rework[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/7b35cd967d34391eccbe2e53bca214d65dfae188.png[/img]

The gallery has been reworked and expanded. It is now much bigger, and has a new area with its distinct atmosphere and display mechanics.

[h3]The Virtualizer[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/0502df36cd70226460844b7fa6e2052c65232e8f.png[/img]

The virtualizer is a new tool which you can use to get a copy, in your gallery, of furniture and other decorative items that you possess in your studio. For a small fee.

It is available in the shop, in the “workshop” tab.

[h3]The Omni Shield[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/879b696d7de9ece040384454903501437f3865a7.png[/img]

The Omni Shield is a new tool. Its advanced technology allows you to protect any surface of your choice from being painted. Blow up those spray cans safely!

It is available in the shop, in the “workshop” tab.

[h3]Other changes and additions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d489194f5840b04c3b3e8a7e960f4f93a36448a6.png[/img]

- The studio has been reworked to offer more space in the main area
- The corridor and elevator can now be accessed again after the introduction
- Unique items from the Story mode are now also available in the Creative mode, from the shop
- Shop: shorter and universal delivery times, replaced delivery timer with a progress bar
- Added step ladders in the shop
- Added 5 new pieces of furniture in the shop
- Lowered the price of many furniture items
- Re-organized the shop categories
- Updated lacquer sprays and added multiple cap variants (now similar to the regular spray cans)
- Faster running speed
- Various optimizations
- Cleaner canvases models

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

- Tablet support has been improved and should work properly with more devices / setups
- Fixed partially broken Journal UI for some screen resolutions
- Fixed some game credit entries
- Fixed some obscure PetBot issues
- Range of minor / other fixes

[h3]Saves compatibility[/h3]

Your old saves should be compatible with the update, with a few quirks:
- Some items may be relocated during the update
- A few walls and floors in the studio (main room, downstairs) have been remodelled for the studio enlargement. Anything you have painted there (walls, floor, ceiling, window, etc) will likely be altered with the update.


If you come across any issues or bugs, please report them either on our Discord server or in the comment below this post, cheers.

We hope you have a fantastic artistic journey – bon voyage!

SuchArt has been in Early Access for a year and a few months, and this period has been indeed fruitful: the game has 97% positive reviews, over 200k wishlists, and almost 800k players taking Creative Space into account – a great amount of work has been put into SuchArt, and we see that you guys appreciate it.

As much as we’d like to keep the intrigue, the title already gave it away – yes, the big moment has arrived, and [b]SuchArt finally leaves Early Access on October 13, 10 AM PT[/b]. Moreover, it also gets its biggest update to yet!

If you’ve been following and (hopefully) enjoying SuchArt for a while now, you can help us spread the word about the game and share it with your friends or, say, your favourite influencer – this would be the greatest help possible!


Set a reminder for October 13, make sure you’ve got enough space on your computer, and get ready to conquer new artistic horizons – your most fascinating creative journey is yet ahead!

notes.title: 1 Day Left: Message from the Developer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/aeb71fae31c93a9dde90368848533cb9b5d15afd.gif[/img]

Heya!

You know, today is the big day. Or rather tomorrow is the big day, since tomorrow SuchArt will go live, but there’s only one day to go, and, I mean, it’s TOMORROW, so today is kinda big too. And big days are perfect for sharing sincere personal messages, right?

As you may know, SuchArt is being developed by only one person — Voolgi. Of course, there are a few people helping him out (including me), but he’s the true creator of this wonderful and inspiring game. Voolgi is fairly outgoing for a solo dev — most of the time you can easily reach out to him on [url=https://discord.com/invite/4vTRcfS]our Discord[/url], he often replies to your comments in Steam discussions, yet his time resources are limited, and therefore I’m responsible for most announcements, Steam updates, tweets, and other public stuff. 

Since today is the (kinda) big day, I decided that it’d be the perfect time to let Voolgi talk and asked him to think of a message he wanted to convey to our lovely community right before the release. And here you go — I now give the floor to Voolgi, the one and only SuchArt dev!

[quote=][i]Hello lovely people,

I have been putting a lot of love and work into the game, and I do hope you will find it relaxing and fun to play. No really, I mean it.

The free Creative Space version got a lot of reviews (I actually read them) and feedback, most being way more positive than I would have dared to dream of. That is a great thing to see, and I really hope the upcoming full version of the game will now meet your expectations as well!

I am now flexing my code-muscles for the inevitable day 1 patch, but afterwards I will totally continue to work on the game for a while. We will keep looking at your feedback and, hopefully, deliver some content accordingly :)

So whether you’re in for fine art painting, for messing around your studio or to ornate every wall you find with some dubious content, I wish you to have the most satisfying painting time and to share your creations with the community <3

And don’t forget: always blame the tools, and be gentle with your PetBot![/i]
[/quote]
– Vincent Delannoy, aka Voolgi


I don’t wanna spoil the perfect outro, so don’t forget to wishlist SuchArt if you haven’t done it yet, and let’s look forward to the release together!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

notes.title: When is SuchArt coming out?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/c87ae3f8a5f9b3b518b200ebe35d630866031a99.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

We know that many of you have been waiting for SuchArt to be released for quite a while now — we get lots of questions about the release date/time every day, we see all of them, yet we can’t give a proper answer, which can possibly be quite disturbing for you. What we definitely don’t want is you being disturbed, that’s why we believe it’s the right time to share our release plans and explain why we’re not giving any specific dates just yet.

First of all, we’d like to reassure you a bit: the game itself is stable — all the core features are ready, and we’re now mainly adding new languages and fixing some minor bugs. Thanks to our awesome Discord community we managed to select people who’ve been helping us with the game testing over the past months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/1f10b268d1aa250c907cac3d8cf0cb889c2ad439.gif[/img]
[i]Please be kind to your PetBot![/i]

There’ll be a lot of stuff awaiting you upon release: a complete story campaign, a separate Creative Mode, a lovely robot assistant PetBot, and many other features related to painting and customizing your studio. Despite all this, SuchArt is likely to be released as an Early Access game. Not because it’s not finished, but because we’re planning to continue adding new features and opportunities to the game based on your future feedback, and Early Access seems to be the best option for such continuous improvements. 

In order for the game to be successful, we need to pick the best release date possible, so it’s one of the most crucial tasks for us at the moment. Release on a bad day can be critical for a small project like ours — there’s always a chance of getting lost among other releases and not getting enough attention and sales at the start (and the first days after the release are actually the most important ones). May and June happened to be extremely replete with releases and other gaming-related events: that’s why we have already postponed SuchArt release several times.

We’ve got a date in mind which we’re now aiming for (don’t worry, it’s in the foreseeable future), and we intend to announce it two weeks before the due date, [b]when we’re 100% sure it won’t change[/b]. We really hope you understand and share our concerns and caution. 

Anyway, thank you so much for looking forward to the full version of SuchArt — it’ll be out pretty soon, just wait a tiny bit more. And you’ll love it, promise! 


[h2]Wishlist SuchArt in order not to miss it:
[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

And, of course, have a beautiful day! <3

notes.title: Top 10 May Paintings From SuchArt Community
notes.content:
Yo,

Hope you’ve all been doing great! Time surely flies fast, and before I knew it, it was time to start compiling this top 10 May post. I could probably go all philosophical here, say that life is fleeting, art is eternal, but don’t worry, I won’t. I’ll just share these 10 awesome paintings with you — I mean, that’s what we’re all here for, right?

As usual, please don’t get upset if you haven’t made it in top 10 (you’re still doing just great, I swear!), and don’t mind the order — this time it’s actually alphabetical, +1 to fairness, you know. 

And, without any further ado, let’s get started (this time I’ve tried to come up with some captions, as promised)!


[h3]cookie the kat[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/af9989ccb33323ae973763328c40b9cf302c7496.jpg[/img]

I’ll be honest with you: I just like the cat from that meme, and I believe the cat likes it here too — who would enjoy a woman constantly shouting at them?

[h3]Dardo[/h3]

notes.title: New full game feature — PetBot
notes.content:
Hey!

Being a genius artist is certainly marvelous. You can explore various artistic mediums and the depths of your inner creativity, breathe life into the seemingly mundane things and even influence the minds of your contemporaries. The whole world is at the tip of your brush, and it’s surely amazing and all that. Yet some of you may be rightfully questioning yourselves: although having endless artistic opportunities is truly wonderful, am I actually capable of handling all this alone? What if I get lonely in the dreary vastness of outer space — no man is an island after all…

Say no more! Ladies and gentlemen, we are delighted to present you the result of an intergalactic technological breakthrough and your new best friend — meet PetBot!

PetBot is an adorable robotic creature that will make your gloomiest day a little bit brighter (even if there are no gloomy days in space). It’s cute and harmless in nature, and, moreover, almost completely autonomous — nobody will steal your precious time in your space studio. To put it briefly, PetBot is your ideal companion! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/3a5a144146bbcc97b08877f14223a702ed6bd73e.png[/img]

Apart from being undeniably cute, PetBot actually has great functionality: it can serve as a cleaning robot and collect all the empty tubes and spray cans thoroughly scattered across your studio and throw them away — say goodbye to the trash piles you’ve been bashfully hiding in your shots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/4465a188aba46710e11b7bf0a12e5b7bb4a8058d.png[/img]

Furthermore, PetBot can clear the paint from any surface, object, or area — a very handy feature that has provoked outrage among the mop and sponge sellers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/e110b963f04a738a27bef7b8f78696bb95e93b0a.gif[/img]

PetBot does not have a voice module, so it will not annoy you with unnecessary talk or say that your art is crap (joking, no art is crap… probably). On the contrary, it will throw holo-hearts at your paintings, making you confident even in your least successful works. And all this will be accompanied by the cute robotic noises — PetBot does not have a voice module, but the sound module is in its proper place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/7d70951a1e5c456e07c94e4b3cf47641315b4830.png[/img]

Although PetBot is not an android, it is not some robot vacuum either and is capable of producing different emotions and reactions that are very similar to the human ones. PetBot gets (or successfully pretends to get) nauseous when turned upside down, dodges spray cans thrown at it and gets truly upset if kicked, just as your real human friend would (kicking your friends is not advised though). 

The cherry on top — you can paint PetBot to your liking, so you’ll be always satisfied with the way it looks (unless you mess up the painting yourself). But since we are talking about SuchArt, that was kind of obvious, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/83dfc73d5369afd6b16429e8f8ef9e75dfdc729e.gif[/img]

As you can see, PetBot is a perfect complement to your studio and the whole in-game experience, available for an extremely generous price of $14.99… whoops, sorry, wrong text. 

Of course, it will be available for free in the full game, which will be released a bit later than expected: we want to deliver it in the best possible way, and it takes some time. Our current plan is to release SuchArt before summer — we will make sure to give you more precise dates as soon as possible, so wishlist the game and stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

To conclude our humble presentation, we would like to remind you that PetBot is still a WIP feature, so in the future it will be capable of doing even more fascinating things, such as producing more advanced emotions or even cryptomining (not for real, sorry). 

PetBot and I wish you a great day — we’ll see you soon! <3

notes.title: First Day: Best Paintings and Results
notes.content:
Hey!

Hope you’ve all had a chance to check Creative Space out, and if not — hurry up and download it, as there’s the giveaway thing going on and stuff. You probably already know about it (if not, read [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293180/view/3031453686297306745]our latest Steam post on the full game page[/url]), and this post is not about it, so yeah, anyway. 

Thanks to you guys being really active, the release actually went quite well: more than 7000 people have installed the game, which is rather impressive, isn’t it?

But most importantly you’ve already created so many awesome works (and it’s been less than 24 hours!!), that we just couldn’t resist sharing them here. We knew it before, but SuchArt community is amazing, really!

If you like Creative Space, please write a Steam review for it — it doesn’t have to be super detailed or anything, but thanks to them Steam algorithms will show the game to more people, which is really important at the stage the project is at now.



Anyway, thank you so much for your support — you’re the best. Keep making great art and have an even greater day!
